title: A UFO control panel inside a hangar
summary: Lyn Buchanan tells of A UFO control panel inside a hangar, about unspecified at A hangar (undisclosed), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: That's where I came across this control panel. And that's when I said, "Hey, that's out of a UFO."
And we passed by this one and here was the control panel of a UFO which I had seen and operated before.
tellings.difference: Adds that the hangar was a metal Quonset building holding midair-collision wreckage, visited about a year after the DIA interview, in the late 1980s.
tellings.link_reason: Buchanan's firsthand account of finding a UFO control panel he recognised in a hangar, which is the event the control-panel story records.

as_told.title: UFO control panel in midair-collision wreckage hangar

plain: Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, says that in the late 1980s, about a year after an interview with the Defense Intelligence Agency, the military's intelligence service, he was taken through a metal hangar holding wreckage from a midair collision. There, he says, he passed a control panel he recognized at once as coming from a UFO, one he says he had seen and operated before, which if true would mean the military held pieces of such craft.
